PageCopy.message_title: Day 1 remains achievable, but two items now sit on the critical path
PageCopy.body: Delivery is broadly to plan. Two items have deteriorated since the last review and neither has an accountable owner: a data-protection risk carrying no mitigation, and an ERP go-live date that has moved without a revised plan behind it. Both need a decision here rather than an escalation next month.
PageCopy.speaker_notes: Expect a challenge on whether the go-live date is contractual. It is an internal target; confirm with Legal before committing either way.

PageCopy.message_title: The data-protection risk is unmitigated and unowned
PageCopy.supporting_message: Highest-scoring open item on the register
PageCopy.callout: This risk was read from a screenshot of the risk dashboard and has not been confirmed against the register itself. Confirm the score before it is minuted.
PageCopy.speaker_notes: If asked who should own this: Legal has the regulatory exposure, but the remediation work sits with IT.

PageCopy.message_title: The ERP go-live has moved without a revised plan behind it
PageCopy.body: The go-live has shifted later than the approved plan, and no replanning has been recorded against the dependent activities. Until that happens the reported date is an aspiration rather than a forecast, and the Day 1 sequence behind it cannot be relied on.

PageCopy.message_title: Forecast spend now exceeds the approved envelope
PageCopy.body: On an actual-cost basis the programme remains inside its approved budget. The current forecast does not, and the movement is concentrated in a small number of one-time items rather than spread across the programme — which makes it addressable if it is addressed now.

PageCopy.message_title: Two decisions are needed from this Committee today
PageCopy.body: Deferring either decision costs optionality rather than money: the mitigation window on the data-protection risk closes as Day 1 approaches.
bullets: Confirm whether the ERP go-live date holds, or mandate a replan against the revised date.

Three things need your attention this week.

The **ERP cutover** is the binding constraint: it has no mitigation owner, and the two trackers disagree about overall progress, so I cannot state a single completion figure with confidence.

The synergy target is not stated in any of the uploaded files, so realisation cannot be calculated yet.
